places.name: Lent Riverside Quarter
places.ai_summary: A historic riverside area featuring charming streets, cafes, and cultural landmarks along the Drava River.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the evening for a lively atmosphere.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a riverside meal at one of the local cafes.

places.name: Old Vine House & Museum
places.ai_summary: Home to the world’s oldest grapevine, this museum celebrates Maribor’s rich wine heritage.

opening_hours.notes: Wine tastings available with prior booking.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the wine tasting experience.

places.name: Glavni Trg & Plague Column
places.ai_summary: The main square of Maribor, featuring the Plague Column, a symbol of gratitude for the end of the plague.

opening_hours.notes: A great spot for people-watching and enjoying local events.

places.place_tip: Check out the local events often held in the square.

places.name: Maribor Castle & Regional Museum
places.ai_summary: A historic castle offering insights into the region's history, culture, and wine-making tradition.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission 30 minutes before closing.

places.place_tip: Explore the wine cellar and enjoy the panoramic view from the tower.

places.name: Maribor Cathedral & Slomšek Square
places.ai_summary: The cathedral is known for its impressive architecture and the square for its vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Attend the Sunday mass for a local experience.

places.place_tip: Respect the local customs, especially during mass.

places.name: Pyramid Hill (Piramida) Hike
places.ai_summary: A popular hiking spot offering stunning views of Maribor and the surrounding vineyards.

opening_hours.notes: Best hiked in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring water and wear good hiking shoes.

places.name: Maribor Pohorje Cable Car & Ski Area
places.ai_summary: A year-round destination for skiing, hiking, and enjoying panoramic views of the Drava Valley.
places.name_english: Maribor Pohorje Cable Car & Ski Area

opening_hours.notes: Check the schedule for cable car and ski lift operations.

places.best_time_to_visit: Winter for skiing, Summer for hiking
places.place_tip: Try the local cuisine at the mountain hut.

places.name: Three Ponds City Park
places.ai_summary: A serene city park featuring three picturesque ponds, walking paths, and picnic areas.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for a peaceful walk or a family picnic.

places.place_tip: Bring birdseed to feed the ducks.

places.name: Water Tower (Vodni stolp) Wine Bar
places.ai_summary: A unique wine bar located in a historic water tower, offering local wines and stunning views.

opening_hours.notes: Reservations recommended for the wine tasting sessions.

places.place_tip: Try the local Styrian wines and enjoy the view.

places.name: Vinag Underground Wine Cellars
places.ai_summary: Explore the fascinating underground wine cellars of Vinag, one of the oldest and most renowned wine cellars in Slovenia.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Book a guided tour for an in-depth experience.

places.name: Betnava Mansion Park
places.ai_summary: A beautiful park surrounding the Betnava Mansion, perfect for a leisurely stroll or a picnic.

opening_hours.notes: The mansion is not open to the public.

places.place_tip: Bring a blanket and enjoy a picnic in the park.

places.name: Maribor Synagogue
places.ai_summary: One of the oldest synagogues in Europe, offering insight into the Jewish heritage of Maribor.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available with prior booking.

places.place_tip: Respect the religious customs and dress modestly.

places.name: Drava River Activities
places.ai_summary: Enjoy various activities on the Drava River, including kayaking, fishing, and cycling along the riverbank.

opening_hours.notes: Check local listings for activity providers and schedules.

places.place_tip: Try kayaking for a unique view of the city.

places.name: Pekrska Gorca Hill
places.ai_summary: A scenic hill offering hiking trails and a chapel, with panoramic views of Maribor and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Visit the chapel and enjoy the peaceful surroundings.

places.name: Rogla Ski & Hike Day Trip
places.ai_summary: A popular destination for skiing in winter and hiking in summer, offering well-marked trails and ski slopes.

opening_hours.notes: Check the weather and trail conditions before visiting.

places.best_time_to_visit: Winter for skiing, Summer for hiking
places.place_tip: Visit the information center for maps and advice.

places.name: Žiče Charterhouse (Carthusian Monastery)
places.ai_summary: A former Carthusian monastery set in a peaceful location, now a cultural monument and event venue.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours available with prior booking.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for concerts and events held at the monastery.

places.name: Ruše Bistrica Gorge Hike
places.ai_summary: A scenic hike through the Ruše Bistrica Gorge, known for its natural beauty and tranquility.

opening_hours.notes: Best hiked in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning scenery.

places.name: Black Lake (Črno jezero) on Pohorje
places.ai_summary: A picturesque glacial lake located on the Pohorje mountain, ideal for hiking and nature photography.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the early morning for tranquility.

places.place_tip: Take the circular trail around the lake for the best views.

places.name: Styrian Wine Route Tasting
places.ai_summary: Experience the best of Styria's wine region with a guided tour and tasting at local wineries.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking is essential, especially during the harvest season.

places.place_tip: Visit multiple wineries for a comprehensive experience.

places.name: Old Bridge (Stari most) Walk
places.ai_summary: A pleasant walk across the Old Bridge, offering beautiful views of the Drava River and the city.

opening_hours.notes: Best walked in the early morning or late afternoon.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the nearby Lent Riverside Quarter.
